subject.title: feat(macos): native-feel dashboard hosting — instant reopen, preload, frame autosave, ⌘N/⌘K, route memory

question: After the correctness and proof blockers are resolved, should the macOS app adopt background dashboard preloading, persistent route restoration, and app-wide ⌘N/⌘K behavior as the supported default?
rationale: These features intentionally change launch work, persisted navigation, window restoration, and global keyboard behavior; code review cannot decide that permanent macOS product contract without the protected owner path.

options.title: Fix, prove, and approve
options.body: Retain the full native-feel feature set after acknowledgment-based commands, exact route restoration, signed-app proof, and macOS/Control UI owner review.

options.title: Narrow the feature set
options.body: Land lower-risk visual and frame improvements separately while deferring preload, route memory, or global shortcuts that lack confirmed product direction.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep current dashboard hosting behavior if the startup work and persistent navigation changes are not worth their upgrade and maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Fix, prove, and approve
recommendation.body: Retain the full native-feel feature set after acknowledgment-based commands, exact route restoration, signed-app proof, and macOS/Control UI owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance explicitly identifies @ngutman with macOS app ownership, covering the native window and application-command contract changed here.
